findings.reason: a gate whose evidence link is unreadable cannot be verified by the later reader it exists for.
findings.text: the g-otmp-design-note Evidence anchor's href is the whole descriptive sentence ("docs/evidence/fragments/... names the single route Choice ...") rather than a path, so the link resolves to nothing and the gate's evidence cannot be opened; the same defect is at line 175 (g-otmp-router-built)

findings.reason: the cited fallout record is unreachable, so a reader cannot check the five fixes the paragraph summarises.
findings.text: the §6 fallout record links `Full record`, but the document defines only ids s1–s11 and no s6-fallout.html exists, so the link is dead while every sibling "Full record" link (s2, s3, s4, s9) resolves to a defined id

findings.reason: a switch condition that holds however the picker behaves cannot refuse the switch, so the plan's central safeguard proves nothing.
findings.text: §6's measure and switch condition "zero dispatches to a refused or logged-out model" cannot fail on the routed path: the plan's own recorded review at line 270 states the figure "is zero by construction on the live pick path because a refused-served candidate is excluded from offered and can never be selected"

findings.reason: the measure that exists to reverse the switch needs its control population re-established, which the plan does not say how to obtain.
findings.text: the shadow stage is described as recording its pick "beside the lane actually used" and the measures as "each compared with deterministic routing over the same period", but after picker-routes-by-default (line 79, routing.picker: route) the lane actually used is itself the picker's pick, so the post-switch shadow delta is trivially zero and the described mechanism can no longer yield the deterministic control arm the done-when and f-otmp-week-compare (line 645) require

rubric_items.anchors_resolve: a finding — both evidence-gate anchors carry their prose inside the href attribute so neither resolves to a file, and the §6 fallout "Full record" link names an id the document does not define.
rubric_items.done_when: a finding — §6's switch condition and headline measure "zero dispatches to a refused or logged-out model" cannot fail on the routed path, so the gate it guards measures nothing.
rubric_items.evidence_paths: pass — gate and followup evidence point at durable paths (docs/evidence/fragments/one-typesafe-model-picker/, docs/evidence/archive/), not a session scratchpad or node-local temp directory.
rubric_items.naming: pass — the mechanism symbols named in the plan's comments (_picker_input, picker_selection, _refuse_against_the_bookend_reserve, reapable_watch_pids) are described by what they do and carry no plan label, ticket number or version tag.
rubric_items.reasoning: a finding — the shadow stage's "compared with deterministic routing over the same period" loses its control arm at the switch, so the mechanism the done-when names cannot produce the comparison it asserts.
rubric_items.single_goal: pass — §6 (the one implementable section) carries the single goal of prototyping and dogfooding the router; its stages and measures are steps to that goal, not separate deliverables.
rubric_items.wiring: pass — plan-after (the-local-lane-is-the-default) and plan-informs (a-window-paces-the-lane, the-local-lane-is-the-default, advise-the-lane-never-force-it) both resolve to plans that exist, and the two evidence gates name their own section and required evidence.
